actions.title: Reconcile and preserve the actual native baseline
actions.required_work: Preserve com.mushavo.budget, signing identity and untracked local edits; reconcile main/audit/native/generated asset versions; verify accepted JDK/SDK/Gradle and clean locked dependency compatibility, then retain the complete Auth/MFA packaging repair.
actions.acceptance: Reviewed actual source/configuration/version mapping; compatible clean dependency/build inputs and real complete assets; no loss of local project/signing identity.

actions.title: Implement and verify native credential storage and migration
actions.required_work: Inspect actual shipped Auth/token stores; wire a supported OS-backed sensitive-storage adapter with no raw-token fallback on failure; plan migration, key invalidation, expiry/revocation, account switch, logout and update/reinstall behavior while preserving appropriate per-account workspace metadata.
actions.acceptance: Actual artifact/store and disposable-device lifecycle evidence shows protected credentials and correct identity boundaries; browser/PWA behavior remains separately verified.

actions.title: Exclude sensitive session/device data from backups and transfers
actions.required_work: Review final merged manifests, supported OS/target versions and all relevant legacy/current backup modes and storage paths; implement narrow exclusions or approved no-backup policy and verify cloud backup, restore and device transfer using disposable data.
actions.acceptance: Final artifact rules match sensitive storage locations and actual supported backup/restore/transfer tests exclude session/device material; no stale identity restored.

actions.title: Complete explicit native origins and validated callbacks
actions.required_work: Establish actual WebView/request origins and precise supported server policy; register validated scheme/host/path links and domain associations; implement cold/warm event dispatch and browser/app state-verifier handoff while retaining verified JWT, identity, role, MFA and tenant authorization.
actions.acceptance: Real supported callbacks succeed; wrong host/path, edited identity, replay, expired/revoked links and account switches fail safely; exact origin enforcement is retained.

actions.title: Harden final permissions, transport and file-sharing scope
actions.required_work: Review merged permissions/components and actual native networking/debug/navigation defaults and overrides; allow only justified access; narrow broad external/cache FileProvider paths to feature-specific app-owned temporary content; validate URI input, recipient, minimum grants, lifetime and cleanup without breaking valid file flows.
actions.acceptance: Final release policy and disposable-device negative/positive permission, transport, URI-grant and cleanup tests demonstrate least required access and safe sharing.

actions.title: Verify actual iOS SDKs, required reasons and privacy archive
actions.required_work: Obtain actual iOS source/target/dependency inventory; align Info.plist, entitlements, required-reason/data declarations and applicable SDK manifests/signatures with shipped behavior and factual privacy decisions; verify target inclusion and final archive privacy report.
actions.acceptance: Signed archive and report contain correct declarations and applicable SDK provenance; actual data use/store disclosures match the shipped artifact.

actions.title: Produce final signed artifacts and real-device release evidence
actions.required_work: After approved remediation/integration, compile/sign the accepted Android/iOS variants and preserve update identity; inspect final merged resources/assets and execute actual device lifecycle, session, routing, finance/permission, file, notification and install-over-existing checks. Complete assigned Stage 9/10 store/recovery/release evidence and fresh full re-audit.
actions.acceptance: Final artifact identities, supported device matrix and release evidence are recorded against the same source/configuration pins; residual findings and release gate are resolved before publication.
